title: KC dads’ carpool app puts an AI assistant in the driver’s seat, eliminating an invisible mental tax
description: A carpool app built from a Kansas City dad’s last-minute, night-before scramble to get his kids where they needed to go, puts schedules, rides and real-time updates in one place, said co-founder Jimmy Carter, emphasizing the role AI assistants can play in everyday life. Source

title: Model ML raises $250m at a $1.5bn valuation for bankers’ AI agents
description: Model ML, a London startup that builds AI agents for bankers, consultants and investors, has raised $250m at a $1.5bn valuation. General Atlantic and QED Investors co-led the Series B round, the company said on Tuesday. Evolution Equity Partners, Airtree, Forestay Capital, Y Combinator, FT Partners, Latitude, Inception Fund and 13Books Capital also took part. […] This story continues at The Next Web
